utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, ladies and gentlemen; good morning to the technical booth, the interpreters, legal assistants, the registrar, the office of the Prosecutor, the Defence counsel and the accused. We are resuming our case. Ms. Hollis, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOLLIS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. Your Honour, The Prosecution would call Witness A. This witness has been granted permission to be heard in closed session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Usher, please take the necessary steps. Just a moment, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I just wanted to take advantage of the time available. I wish the Prosecution to tell us that all the documents have been disclosed to the Defence related to the credibility of the witness. That is all I should like to hear from the Prosecution, that we have been given everything that has to do with the credibility of this witness. That is all, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] You are aware of the special situation regarding this witness. You're not talking about that?

utterances.speaker: MS. HOLLIS
utterances.text: Your Honour, to the knowledge of the Prosecution, the Prosecution has made the Defence aware of matters known to us under Rule 68.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We hope that there will be no surprises. Mr. Fila.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We will in the appeals proceedings, but not now.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Usher, please lower the blinds and bring the witness in. And we are going now into closed session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Friday, the 15th day of September, 2000, at 9.30 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.10 p.m.,
